svg.title: Lightweight POS: What the Restaurant Terminal Should Keep and Let Go
svg.desc: Left: frontline capabilities kept at the restaurant terminal that cannot stop on site. Right: responsibilities handed to the omnichannel transaction hub and data foundation, where centralised handling works better. Light means clear responsibility boundaries, not fewer features.
